retrieved_context: Ready to Die: Ready to Die is the debut studio album by American rapper The Notorious B.I.G.; it was released on September 13, 1994, by Bad Boy Records and Arista Records.  The label's first release, the album features production by Bad Boy founder Sean "Puffy" Combs, Easy Mo Bee, Chucky Thompson, DJ Premier and Lord Finesse, among others.  Recording for the album took place during 1993-94 at The Hit Factory and D&D Studios in New York City.  The partly autobiographical album tells the story of B.I.G.'s experiences as a young criminal.  "Ready to Die" was the only studio album released during his life, as he was murdered sixteen days prior to the release of his second album, "Life After Death" in 1997.

Unbelievable (The Notorious B.I.G. song): Unbelievable is a song by American rapper The Notorious B.I.G., recorded for his debut studio album Ready to Die.  It samples R. Kelly’s “Your Body’s Calling” and Honey Drippers' “Impeach the President”.
